newsitem.title: FINLAND: AMER SEES ATOMIC EARNINGS IMPROVING IN '97.
newsitem.headline: AMER SEES ATOMIC EARNINGS IMPROVING IN '97.

text.p: Finnish sport goods group Amer-yhtyma Oy said in a company newsletter received on Tuesday that earnings of its Atomic ski making unit were likely to improve this year.
"Atomic's earnings are likely to improve this year when the restructuring and the reorganisation of production start to take effect," Amer said.
In 1996, Atomic posted a 54 million markka operating loss.
Referring to prospects for the entire Amer group, CEO Roger Talermo said in the newsletter: "The restructuring phase is over. The situation is now stable although certainly not easy."
"Towards the end of the year earnings should improve," Talermo said according to the newsletter.
In 1996, Amer fell to a 234 million markka loss before extraordinary items and taxes.
Amer has repeatedly said it expects group earnings to improve but that the full-year 1997 result may remain in the red. --Helsinki newsroom +358-9-680 50 245, e-mail news@reuters.fi
